subheadline: Workshops, onboarding sessions and project kick-offs take place at the studio at Musterstraße 12 in Berlin.

routes.description: The nearest tram stop is a four-minute walk from the studio. From the main station, the trip takes about 15 minutes.
Street parking nearby is short-stay and paid on working days. Public transport is the easier way to reach us.
There are bike racks in the courtyard, next to the entrance.
